title: ReviewEnvelope
description: An externally-authored, structured human review of one opportunity candidate, imported after analyst execution has already completed and been hashed. Independent means independent of analyst execution: not generated by the analyst provider, not a second same-provider critique, not produced by the worker agent that ran the trial. It is not a claim that the reviewer is an independent market or an independent research organization -- a reviewer who is the product owner must disclose that via reviewer.conflict, and such a review is still not market validation. The nested verdict reuses the existing CriticVerdict schema and fields unchanged.

id.description: A stable identifier for this reviewer that does not itself carry PII (e.g. a pseudonymous handle, not an email address).

conflict.description: Explicit conflict-of-interest disclosure, e.g. 'none' or 'product_owner'. Required on every review -- never silently omitted.

opportunity_hash.description: Hash of the OpportunityCard as exported. review import re-derives this from the current store and rejects the envelope if it no longer matches (stale or tampered).

evidence_manifest_hash.description: Hash of the evidence.jsonl exported for this card. Re-derived and checked the same way as opportunity_hash.

recommended_status.description: Non-authoritative. observed and externally_validated are not recommendable, human or model.

evidence_ids.description: Must belong to the opportunity card under review -- review import rejects an objection evidence_id that exists but belongs to a different card.

fatal.description: True means this objection alone should block experiment_ready. The deterministic judge, not the reviewer, has final say.
